scope: Correct trusted-catalogue propagation through Still Media .rlsound recovery.

checks: Code-owned SOUNDTRACK_CATALOGUE is the default. The host validates and privately owns it before creating navigation, manager or media resources; imported saved claims never replace authority.
The same trusted catalogue is passed to soundtrackPortableRecoveryPlan and exportSoundtrackBundle. The preflight and serialization therefore use the same rights, hash and ownership rules.

Plan.requiredTracks drives a useful named missing-original refusal. The exporter still verifies actual MP3 hashes/metadata and excludes denied/unknown recovery hashes; the host does not weaken importer/reference completeness rules.

Recovery status names reference-only songs, includes the shared without-audio/approved-source notice, and retains it after the Download action. Unused online entries receive the distinct omission notice.

The first post-read cancellation/current-task guard prevents late reads from updating state. The existing post-export guard remains. The retained notice is set only after the current-task fence and is cleared with the old URL.

HTML now accurately states shared DB5 and permitted-original/reference recovery. Its final guidance directs missing recordings to Music library & playlists rather than ambiguously saying no music is downloaded.
The legacy-v1 backup assertion remains and is renamed to reflect current DB5. The new tests do not replace or relax prior host ownership/cancellation assertions.
